reviews.author: Gavin park
reviews.text:
This is a traditional Turkish dessert cafe located on the main street in Itaewon-dong, Yongsan-gu. After having breakfast at Myeongdong Gyoza with my wife, I happened to see it while walking around and went in.
Beautiful, colorful baklava, lokum, cookies, etc. are neatly waiting for customers.
The female owner, who appears to be a Turkie, speaks Korean well, so even if you don't know much about it, there is no inconvenience at all in buying this or that. We got a small kaymak and some baklava, which we were very curious about, and it came out to about 25,000 won. The price is a bit expensive compared to the size. When I brought it home and tasted it, the baklava was wow! It's so sweet. I thought the layers would be crispy, but it looks like the layers were boiled in sugar water. I tried one or two and put them in the refrigerator... The sugar content is too much to eat three.
Kaymak said he should have bought a simit from the store. When I tried it on the bread I bought at home, the scent of grain bread was so strong that I couldn't tell what the kaymak taste was. I don't enjoy walking around the city and it's very sweet, so I don't know if I'll use it again, but I'd like to try Lokum or cookies next time.

reviews.author: Seongbin Noh
reviews.text:
I tried baklava for the first time and it was very sweet and delicious.
Goes well with Turkish black tea.

Lokum has a similar texture to market jelly, but is more luxurious and very sweet.

Dondurma is moderately chewy and delicious.

Türkiye cookies tasted like ordinary cookies.

The Kaimak set was nice because it provided a lot of bread, honey, and Kaimak.
I don't know what the mainland Turkish kaymak is like, but it was softer and softer than other kaymaks I've tried in Korea.

reviews.author: Yeon Woo Kim
reviews.text:
You can eat traditional Turkish bread, kaymak, baklava, etc. The seats are very narrow. There are 6 2-person tables, but if you make it a 4-person table, there are only 4 table seats.
There is a kaymak set so you can taste the main bread and kaymak.
Black tea is not a different taste than Turkish black tea, it just tastes like a tea bag.

reviews.author: Minhee Hwang
reviews.text: A place where you can taste everything from baklava to Turkish delight in Seoul. Baklava is a bit pricey, but you will understand once you taste it. You can also enjoy Turkish coffee and black tea, so it's worth a visit if you want a unique dessert. Baklava cookies are also great as gifts.

reviews.author: Kai Lee
reviews.text:
Itaewon Station Kervan Bakery - Order baklava and Turkish ice cream

You must try baklava, which has a thin pastry layer, sweet honey flavor, and savory nuts that go well together.
A house that makes you feel good thanks to the friendly owner and part-time workers.

reviews.author: Taemi Lee
reviews.text:
I visited on a weekday and was happy to see so many breads!
I usually come here once a week because May Uijong bread is popular.
There wasn't much bread to choose from.
There are many breads that are both healthy and delicious.
There were a lot of people when I arrived.
I quickly chose my favorite breads and paid for them.
The cutting is also meticulous.
It's better value for money than other bakeries.
Cranberry baguette 4,500 won, rye sticks 2,500 won, fig rye 4,500 won, walnut cream cheese 3,500 won. Right?
Ah, the crunchier the baguette is, the more savory it becomes.
Rye sticks, not too much, just a little bit too much.
Walnut cream cheese is so flavorful...
Fig Rye is a fantastic combination of fig and rye with an understated sweetness.
Please note that there are no seats.
I'll have to stop by again on a weekday and pick up some bread.

A special place to have dessert at the bar
Dessert can be served with tea or alcohol.
It feels like a lot of effort went into each menu item, with fresh combinations and flavors. How did you come up with these combinations? Innovative desserts you'll want
I wanted to go once a day and try all the menu items.

The most delicious thing among them was the queso.
A combination of Manchego cheese cream, vanilla cream, olive oil, etc. on top of the cheesecake. As soon as I took a bite, I was moved.
A taste that anyone who loves cheese will fall in love with
Even if you don’t like cheese that much, you can probably eat it well because it has the right combination of sensitivities!! I want to eat it again..

The wood had the predictable scent of burdock cream, so it didn't have much of an impact. The queso was really great... The other things are delicious too, but the queso is really fresh and unique.

reviews.author: Yijin Kim (Jane)

The more you look at the pink coral reef, the more beautiful it gets.
It's such a waste to cut with a knife, I just want to look at it (fool)...

Pink coral, Basharlotte, recommended mild-tasting oolong tea, recommended refreshing cocktail

Pear Charlotte is a petit gateau made with domestic pears that are crunchy and have a nice refreshing taste. I used the pears very well to make a refreshing and refreshing petit gateau. Because there was a lot of cream, it could be greasy, but perhaps because of my stomach, it wasn't greasy at all and it didn't feel burdensome at all.

Pink coral topped dacquoise with delicious cream, strawberries, and other things. Is the white jelly-like thing on top flavored with mint? I think this jelly had a slightly salty taste. I think they used a little bit of salt to bring out the flavor, but the taste was really interesting. Overall, you can eat it without getting bitten due to the rich, nutty taste of pistachios, sweet strawberry, and mint flavor that adds refreshingness.

It was a place that utilized a variety of materials well while maintaining a good balance without going overboard. It was fun to feel the delicacy, and I thought that was why it was so popular because it felt big.

Jaein, the experimental pinger of the dessert world.
It is famous for its uniquely flavored desserts made with oriental ingredients such as sesame seeds, Cheongyang peppers, and burdock, but it also has delicious standard desserts.

Hatch, a variation from Mont Blanc, made with sesame seeds and jujubes was impressive, and the bitter-sweet Forrenoir with dark chocolate shavings and kirsch cream added to biori was also very good.
Due to the nature of the store, there may be a lot of menus that differ in preferences, but both menus I tried this time were successful!

Please note that ordering tea or alcohol is required to eat in the store.

Too pretentious. It is a nice place. Don’t get me wrong. It’s just that the way the workers treat and how they operate the space were a bit too much. Desserts are good, but not one a kind either. It could have been more relaxing. Less tension.

The dessert quality is good, but I don't think it's anything special. I have no intention of returning.

reviews.author: MENA KI
reviews.text: A restaurant that pursues simple, clean taste against the trend of excessive bagels overflowing with various creams and toppings and chewy bagels with a rice cake-like texture. It's crispy on the outside, moderately chewy on the inside, and the cream cheese isn't too much so it doesn't spoil the taste of the bread. There are many bagels with toppings added, but the amount is not excessive, so they maintain their identity as bagels. I remember the refreshing combination of cream cheese with jalapenos spread on a bagel.

reviews.author: Min
reviews.text:
A German-style bagel restaurant located in the back streets of Itaewon. The farmhouse-style interior is pretty cute. Perhaps because it was remodeled from a multi-family house, the interior of the cafe is divided into rooms, giving it a more cozy feel. The third floor is unique because it has a fireplace and a bed. It's not easy to get a seat on weekends, but compared to other popular bagel shops in Seoul (Elephant, London Bagel Museum), there's no wait and it's much easier.
The coffee tastes pretty average, and the bagel is pretty good too. If you've already tried Elephant or London bagels, you won't be satisfied with the bagels here. It felt a little more chewy than the two stores, but it didn't feel unpleasantly tough, but it wasn't the best bagel anyway.

reviews.author: martinus

They also sell coffee and beer along with bagels, so it seems like they can cater to a variety of tastes. The bagels are definitely delicious, but they are a bit tough, perhaps because they are made in advance.

I went on a day when the weather was nice, and it felt really good to enjoy drinks and coffee in an open space. If you ever happen to be nearby, please make sure to visit!

A place where you can purchase various madeleines and baked goods
Personally, I think it tastes better than some famous madeleines. (Personal taste evaluation)
There are madeleines with unique flavors, and new flavors are released periodically.
The price is not cheap (around 3,000 won to around 5,000 won), but it is not a waste of money to get a madeleine of this quality.

The staff is friendly and explains the taste and ingredients in detail, helping me choose my madeleine from a variety of madeleines.

The store is on the second floor and may be difficult to find due to the small sign, but the inside of the store is cozy.

I usually visit on weekdays, so the seats are empty, but there are many people taking out takeout.

reviews.author: Jason Lim
reviews.text: A variety of madeleines are served regularly, making me happy every time I go. If there's one thing that's disappointing, it's that there are only a few tables. It would be nice if some of the seats could be turned into bar tables for one person looking out at the window.

reviews.author: Joon Smith
reviews.text: This is a baked snack shop located in a small alley. A variety of baked goods were on display. I purchased the Classic Canelette, Sumi Potato Madeleine, and Pistachio Calette Breton. Although it was a bit pricey, all the products I purchased were of good quality and I enjoyed them. The store owner(?) who served us was friendly and gave us friendly service, making it a memorable store.

reviews.author: Taste Log
reviews.text:
I've been to a few high-end dessert shops, and even though Legion d'Etre is a branch, the taste was pretty good. There are also relatively inexpensive desserts, so it's a great place to enjoy without stress.

I visited around evening and was disappointed that some of the desserts were sold out. Popular menu items seem to sell out early, so it might be a good idea to keep that in mind.

It was also interesting that it was an open kitchen, so you could see the desserts being made.

The rose egg was more unique and delicious than the duck dessert.

reviews.author: Jingju Park
reviews.text: I didn't know this was a chain restaurant ^^ I was so drawn to this place while walking down the street that I went in, and the coffee was delicious and the desserts were so pretty that I was constantly amazed!! I’ve tried bread pudding and salt bread, and salt bread is really trendy these days… It's a little different from other salt breads that are soft, but it's firm and light, but it's creamy and has an amazing taste👍🏻🥰 I'll go there often. It's a place I like.

reviews.author: Jane Kim
reviews.text: I visited for the first time not long after it opened. It's great to see another dessert restaurant in the neighborhood. I visited around 8 o'clock on a weekday and there were no customers, so I ate comfortably. I visited late at night, so they didn't have all the cake menus, but I visited after the meal and was able to try only one cake. The cake was detailed and the taste combination was really good, and the coffee was also good. The best part is that all the breads and desserts are not on open display, but are kept in a showcase, which is great. In cafes, of course, the cakes are in the showcase, but the breads are all open, so it's really uncomfortable and unhygienic. I liked the cleanliness of the owner here. I plan to visit again soon and try other cakes. The interior is simple and nothing special, but I liked that the store and the bread-making kitchen inside the store were very organized and looked hygienic. The employees and the owner who work in the store are also friendly!

A huge bakery located on the main street in Hannam-dong.
There are seats, but it's actually very cluttered, so it's difficult to sit and enjoy coffee or bread comfortably. The space is spacious, but there are more people, so it's quite crowded.

When you enter the huge entrance, you will see the entrance on the right, and on the left there is an elevator that allows you to move between floors and view the sights.

There are a huge number of breads, cakes, sandwiches, and a variety of colorful products you've never heard of.

The prices are extremely expensive, and it's worth trying a couple just for Instagram, but the only products that sell consistently are sandwiches and some salads. They are being sold in such large quantities that you wonder if they can all be sold in one day, and the cakes seem to be sold in the range of 50,000 to 150,000 won. reviews.text:
A restaurant specializing in pizza and hamburgers
Located a 7-minute walk from Exit 3 of Itaewon Station.
The beef slice burger set is 10,500 won.

Ketchup taste~
This place sells a variety of burgers and pizza.
The beef slice burger consists of a bun, patty, sliced beef, lettuce, tomato, stir-fried onion, and cheese.
Compared to the visuals, it's a pretty solid composition.
The burger tastes reminiscent of memories, with the vegetable flavor not as strong as expected and the ketchup flavor being stronger.
The bread was so crumbly that it brought back memories of the cafeteria when I was in school.
The sliced beef is slightly tough and has a weak taste, so there may be some people who like it or not.
The French fries were thick and good to eat on their own.
It's unfortunate that the amount is small, but this is acceptable.

Store & Tips & Review
The store is small and there are not many tables.
The spacing between tables is narrow, so it's a bit frustrating.
Still, there are window seats, so it's okay to eat alone.
Ordering and payment are carried out at the counter.
When cooking is complete, the menu is called out, so you can pick it up and clean it up after eating.
As it is in Itaewon, the store is run by a foreigner(?) who speaks Korean, so ordering is not difficult.
And except for me, all the guests were foreigners(?).
It seems like you mostly eat hamburgers.
In addition to hamburgers, they also sell pizza and side dishes.
Both hamburgers and pizza don't feel as expensive as you might think.
If you have fond memories of your childhood like me, this is a burger you can easily eat until the end.
However, if you expect a handmade burger overflowing with oil and juice, you may be a little disappointed.

Subway Itaewon Station branch is located right next to the station exit, making it the most convenient option when you're busy or just want a quick meal. The optimal location makes it perfect for grabbing a sandwich before going out or replenishing energy after exploring the lively streets of Itaewon. The interior is clean, bright and practical. It's not fancy, but it has everything you need.

Sandwiches offer classic Subway flavors, including fresh vegetables, the option to add your favorite toppings, and a variety of sauces. I can't say the taste is particularly outstanding, but the quality is consistently excellent and it makes for a quick and filling meal. If you're looking for something a little different, this might not be the place for you, but if you're looking for a tasty turkey or veggie sandwich, this is a satisfying choice.

What makes this Subway special is that it plays an important role in Itaewon’s daily life. It is not a destination, but a place that is established as a reliable stopover. It can be a comfortable option for those who have a busy commute, a casual meeting, or are tired of spicy Korean food. You can think of it as a place that provides a strong support among exciting restaurants, like a familiar alley friend in the intense taste of Itaewon.

reviews.author: Chanho Andrew Kim (MUYO)
reviews.text:
This is a precious espresso bar found on a hill in Bogwang-dong. It is a small cafe run by the barista himself, and although the variety is not very diverse, I thought he was a talented person who makes cream that goes really well with coffee. The creams for granita, conpana, and tiramisu all have different viscosities, so I was impressed that they maximize the taste of the espresso. In particular, I thought that the best conpana was the combination of savory coffee and sweet cream, as written in the note provided.
This is an espresso bar that you want to visit when you want to enjoy espresso in comfort.

reviews.text: I've been to a lot of espresso restaurants, but this one was really special. In particular, the signature espresso menu was unique. reviews.text: This store has a very significant geographical disadvantage. It's really hard to get to..ㅠㅠ However, considering the atmosphere of the store, the cute dog in the inner yard, and the taste of the coffee, I would 100% revisit this place. The taste of coffee, which is the basis of a cafe, is really good. I heard that flat white is famous, so I tried both brewed and flat white, and it was just as good. The brewed coffee, which was a very smooth flat white, captured the flavor of the coffee well. What's also impressive is that the store's employees work in theater and acting. Maybe that's why they all look good, have outstanding skills, and are kind.
